paragraphs.text: Lam is a human monk from Tarkir .

Lam has seen it all—the effects of the Khanfall , rule under Dragonlord Ojutai , the New Phyrexian Invasion , the birth of Shiko , and Narset 's appointment to Waymaster . Once a young monk with no strong aspirations, Lam found joy in living a humble life and recounting heroic tales to the delight of his Jeskai peers and elders. It was only after Cori Mountain monks and civilians gathered to thank him for his decades of mentorship and historical preservation that Lam even realized he'd become a beloved and renowned teacher. Now, Lam retains his youthful vigor for life as he continues to teach fighting techniques and the history behind them to young monks—and their teachers.
